@@U02320@@
in groups and pairs,
fondly mingling,
groups forming and groups dissolving,
in and out,
no fear of propriety.
The world with its untold fund of follies
remains unchanged:
one great, grand Fool!

@@U02322@@
(Singing to mandolins.)

@@U02323@@
Drawn here by your courtly splendor
Decked out in all our best are we,
Maids of Florence, come to render
Tribute to your courtesy.
In our curly nut-brown hair
We have woven bright spring flowers,
Silken threads, and streamers fair,
As if plucked from nature’s bowers.
We truly hope to win your praises
For our very special art;
Our flowers bloom all year in glazes,
Artificial and very smart.
Scraps of every color mingle,
Ordered to content your taste;
You may scoff at them in single,
But not en masse in order placed.
Charming are we to the sight,
Darlings to the eye and heart,
For womans nature is bound tight
To the very soul of art.

@@U02325@@
Lovely ladies, show us now
the brimming baskets you bear on your heads,
and your bulging armloads of colorful flowers.
translation:
@@U02320@@
成群结对地，
深情地交融，
团体的形成和团体的解散，
进出，
不畏礼节。
这个世界充满了无数的愚蠢行为
保持不变：
一位伟大的愚人！

@@U02322@@
（对着曼陀林唱歌。）

@@U02323@@
被你的宫廷光彩吸引到这里
我们打扮得漂漂亮亮，
佛罗伦萨的少女们，来渲染吧
向您的礼貌致敬。
在我们坚果棕色的卷发中
我们编织了灿烂的春花，
丝线、飘带公平，
仿佛是从大自然的凉亭里摘下来的。
我们真诚地希望赢得您的好评
为了我们非常特殊的艺术；
我们的花一年四季都在釉里绽放，
人工且非常聪明。
各种颜色的碎片混合在一起，
订购以满足您的口味；
你可能会单方面嘲笑他们，
但不是按顺序排列的。
我们的目光迷人，
眼睛和心灵的宠儿，
因为女人的本性是被束缚的
直达艺术的灵魂。

@@U02325@@
可爱的女士们，现在就让我们看看吧
你头上顶着装满的篮子，
还有你那满抱的五颜六色的花朵。
